intent: Ship the first truthful live Dharma Helm slice from current main: one safe no-tools primary-agent turn, a fixed seven-seat read-only OnCall projection produced only by Python RouteVerification evidence, a persistent terminal N/7 truth band, and fail-closed command outcomes and compound-intent handling. Preserve raw input, admit no mutation or evolution effects, and keep unavailable or unverifiable routes UNKNOWN or LIVE_DEGRADED.

gates.name: helm-slice1-python-regression
gates.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_route_verification.py tests/test_model_status_projection.py tests/test_terminal_bridge.py tests/tui/test_claude_adapter_v11.py tests/tui/test_codex_adapter.py tests/tui/test_openrouter_adapter.py

gates.name: helm-slice1-python-ruff
gates.command: python3 -m ruff check dharma_swarm/model_status.py dharma_swarm/terminal_bridge.py dharma_swarm/terminal_bridge_chat.py dharma_swarm/terminal_bridge_session_runtime.py tests/test_route_verification.py tests/test_model_status_projection.py tests/test_terminal_bridge.py

negative_controls.name: route-verification-ttl-regression-detected
negative_controls.command: python3 -c "import pathlib, subprocess, sys; p=pathlib.Path('dharma_swarm/model_status.py'); t=p.read_text(); old='MAX_ROUTE_VERIFICATION_TTL = timedelta(hours=24)'; new='MAX_ROUTE_VERIFICATION_TTL = timedelta(hours=48)'; (t.count(old) == 1) or sys.exit(3); p.write_text(t.replace(old,new,1)); sys.exit(subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pytest','tests/test_route_verification.py::test_route_verification_rejects_ttl_over_24_hours','-q']).returncode)"

commit.message: feat(helm): ship truthful read-only live slice

interface_mismatches: Current model_status live_routable states and terminal routePolicy ready states are alternate positive constructors without the Slice-1 RouteVerification proof obligations.
Current terminal command-result rendering maps ok=false and stub results to complete/success-like UI states.
Current bridge intent inference can collapse the locked compound adversarial prompt into /swarm and trust caller-supplied bootstrap intent.
honest_blockers: At base, only Kimi K3 and Claude Opus 4.8 match two of the seven locked logical seats exactly; Fable 5, GPT-5.6, Grok 4.5-4.6 lineage, Fugu Ultra, and Claude Opus 5.0 are not registered as exact routes.
Both authenticated Kimi K3 delegation routes returned HTTP 403 usage-limit errors on 2026-08-09; the failure is recorded externally and no purchase or quota change is authorized.

The current Codex CLI adapter exposes a shell tool and therefore cannot satisfy the Slice-1 no-tools primary-turn membrane without additional physical enforcement; it is excluded from safe live proof until such enforcement is proven.
Full seven-of-seven live proof depends on provider availability and credentials and must remain LIVE_DEGRADED or LIVE_PROOF_BLOCKED if any seat cannot produce fresh identity evidence.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the packet-scoped commit. The slice introduces no migration and no durable positive route-truth store; reconnect or runtime-epoch change resets the terminal projection to UNKNOWN.
